_dataset.name: json-output
_dataset.title: Structured JSON output
_dataset.description: Asks for JSON and checks validity, keys, types and values; partial credit per check.

prompt: Return only a JSON object, with no other text. Keys: "name" (string) and "age" (integer). Person: Alice is 30 years old.
Return only a JSON object, with no other text. It must have a key "capital" whose value is the capital city of France.
Return only a JSON object, with no other text. Keys "a", "b" and "sum", where a is 4, b is 9 and sum is a plus b.
Return only a JSON object, with no other text. It must have a boolean key "is_even" that says whether 42 is an even number.
Return only a JSON array (no other text) containing the first three prime numbers.
Return only a JSON object, with no other text. Describe the colour red with keys "name" (string) and "hex" (a hex code such as "#FF0000").
Return only a JSON object, with no other text. Keys "city" (string) and "population" (integer). Text: Jakarta has about 11 million people.
Return only a JSON array (no other text) with the English names of the two days of the weekend.
